what_this_is: Pfizer's correctly scoped D02 - 92 excerpts, the set that the item bound refused - carried through native Run creation, freeze, a separate-process cold read and the public row. Clean process, the implementation on disk, no substitution of any kind.
not_the_earlier_probe: The earlier PUBLIC_ROW result was reached with render_text_payload rebound in-process and is a feasibility probe only. This one is the acceptance: nothing is patched at runtime, and the cold read runs in a separate interpreter against the frozen run directory.
what_it_shows: 92 items and 41,860 rendered characters reach a FROZEN Run with quality EXACT and publication PUBLISHED.
The Run declares catalog/r6/D02_legal_disclosures_v2.md by byte hash, so the capacity it used is the one its own Spec declares.
A separate process reloads the frozen run and returns the same run_id, the same FROZEN status and the same 92 items, having recompiled the Spec and re-rendered the payload.
92 Evidence entries and one public row, with new provider/paid/SEC calls all zero.
what_it_does_not_show: That the 92 excerpts are the right 92. Evidence PASS and a frozen Run are not business content acceptance; that state is separate and still False.

cost_measured.note: A 32-item D02 took about 105 seconds before the shared-source work and 64 after; 92 items take 235. The growth is in the existing per-observation machinery, not in the capacity lookup, which measures 0.032 ms per call against a warm cache.

wiring_is_separately_tested.why_it_is_separate: The module being correct is not the same as it being reached. The item bound is enforced at five places across three files, and only the registration patch routes them, so an isolated module test would pass with nothing wired.
wiring_is_separately_tested.payload: 92 items, the size Pfizer's D02 produces
wiring_is_separately_tested.skip_rule: skips unless the patch is applied, detected by reading the three patched modules' own source rather than the patch file, so a half-applied patch skips rather than reporting a pass. A skip is not a pass and it is not registered in any fast tier.
wiring_is_separately_tested.the_negative: Each case runs twice - once declaring the revised Spec's identity, once declaring the predecessor's - and the second must be refused. Accepting both would mean the route simply raised the bound for everyone.
wiring_is_separately_tested.negative_proven_load_bearing: Forcing the ceiling lookup to return 192 for every identity in the patched runtime made all three cases fail; restoring it made all three pass.
wiring_is_separately_tested.measured: 3 cases, 0.01 seconds in the patched runtime; 3 skips in the repository checkout
